purpose: No-secret deployment input; root applies through native admin APIs after adapter deployment. This document is not itself an API request body.

native_configuration.name: openai_connection
native_configuration.mode: Read current config in memory; confirm no existing configured providers or exactly this approved connection before replacing connection arrays. Preserve unrelated top-level fields. Stop if another provider is found. For an existing enabled trusted OAuth connection, configure-model-access.mjs input mode=responses-only updates only api_type using GET /openai/config, POST /openai/config/update and GET readback; it does not enable connections or apply other settings.

native_configuration.name: global_model_directory_cache
native_configuration.mode: Read, merge patch into full response, POST full response; retain both direct-connection settings.

native_configuration.name: default_chat_model
native_configuration.mode: Read, merge patch into full response, POST full response. Nullable required fields still need their keys; preserve optional metadata and params to avoid writing null.

native_configuration.name: external_task_model
native_configuration.mode: Read, merge patch into full response, POST full response. Preserve TASK_MODEL and all generation switches/prompts. Do not invoke title/completions during configuration verification.

native_configuration.name: disable_dedicated_image_generation_and_edits
native_configuration.mode: Read config only in memory, require IMAGE_GENERATION_ENGINE == openai for the reviewed no-upstream-call path, merge patch and POST full response. Never log or persist full responses. Stop for review if the engine differs.

verification_contract.config_save_identity: Recovery admin native session may save config. That account has no main-site OAuth session and must not pass an upstream OAuth connection test.
verification_contract.free_authenticated_models_check: After a fresh main-site OAuth login with offline_access, GET /api/models?refresh=true using that user's OWUI session; assert actual returned IDs and check native OWUI model visibility grants for a normal user.
verification_contract.free_upstream_anonymous_check: GET https://api.pingxingxian.space/oauth-relay/v1/models without Authorization must fail with 401.
verification_contract.quota_behavior: Adapter contract: authenticated bound users may list three models at zero quota; billable chat/completions and responses use native per-user balance rejection. No grant of quota is part of this template.
verification_contract.native_model_registration_plan: Apply openwebui-native-model-records-plan.json for the three approved IDs and user:* read grants; v0.12.5 hides unregistered models from normal users. No global access-control bypass.
verification_contract.cache_limit: Global base-model cache is disabled; native per-user OpenAI enumeration cache defaults to one second. Empty fetches may reuse BASE_MODELS. A visible model is not authorization to spend.
verification_contract.identity_coverage: Source verified for model enumeration, chat/completions including streaming and image input, responses, and external task/title calls. No real model call has been tested by this agent. Dedicated image generation/edit remains disabled.
